name: What's the difference between a thermostatic and pressure-balancing shower valve?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a thermostatic and pressure-balancing shower valve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both thermostatic and pressure-balancing shower valves regulate water temperature, but they do so differently. A pressure-balancing valve reacts to sudden changes in water pressure (e.g., someone flushing a toilet) to prevent scalding or freezing, maintaining a consistent temperature by adjusting the hot and cold water mix. A thermostatic valve, on the other hand, maintains a precise, pre-set temperature regardless of pressure fluctuations or incoming water temperature changes. Thermostatic valves offer finer control and often include a volume control separate from temperature, providing a more consistent and luxurious shower experience.
